objective: Reject ambiguous JSON evidence before semantic canonicalization or attestation.
completed_slices: Implemented a strict JSON evidence parser that rejects duplicate member names before ordinary parser collapse.
Detected escaped member-name equivalence such as a and \u0061 as duplicate identity.
Bound accepted input to a raw UTF-8 SHA-256 digest while keeping raw-byte identity distinct from semantic canonicalization.
Verified five deterministic acceptance and fail-closed cases.
acceptance_remaining: Integrate this boundary before the canonical JSON digest and evidence-envelope attestation path.
Differential-test against independent strict JSON parsers and a duplicate-key adversarial corpus.
Add a byte-level UTF-8 decoder boundary so malformed byte sequences fail before string parsing.
Add bounded depth and input-size limits for hostile or accidental resource exhaustion.
safe_next_action: Compose raw-byte retention, strict duplicate-aware parsing, RFC 8785 canonicalization, and dual-digest attestation in that order; preserve failure codes and never canonicalize already-collapsed JSON.parse output as primary evidence.
